translations.text: And they drew you; we will run after the fragrance of your oils. The bride tells the maidens about the bridegroom and what he bestowed on her: The king brought me into his chamber. After the bride has told the maidens, they say: We will rejoice and be glad in you, and we will love your breasts more than wine. The maidens speak to the bride in the bridegroom’s name: Uprightness loved you.
The bridegroom says to the bride: Behold, you are beautiful, my companion; behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are doves.
The bride says to the maidens: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and the mighty forces of the field, not to stir up or awaken love until it wishes.
For behold, winter has passed; the rains have passed and gone away.

When I had passed a little beyond them, I found the one whom my soul loved. Having found the bridegroom, she says: I held him and did not let him go until I brought him into my mother’s house and into the chamber of the one who conceived me.
Your neck is like David’s tower, which is built in Talpioth. A thousand shields hang from it, and all the arrows of armed warriors.
My nephew stretched his hand through the window, and my belly was stirred for him.

The daughters of Jerusalem and the guards of the walls ask the bride: What is your nephew compared with other nephews, you who are beautiful among women? What is your nephew compared with other nephews, that you have adjured us so?
His legs are marble pillars set upon golden bases. His appearance is like the choicest fir trees of Lebanon.
Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pool of Heshbon at the gates of many daughters. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon that looks toward Damascus.
How beautiful you have become, and how sweet you have become, O love, in your delight!
If only you, my nephew, had nursed at my mother’s breasts! Finding you outside, I would kiss you, and you would not despise me.
Our sister is little, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day when she is spoken to?
